name: workhub-marketplace
description: Claude Code marketplace bundled with the workhub app: the single source of plugins for the workhub vault harness (task board, engineering workflows, productivity tools, and tech-stack helpers). See docs/plugins.md for the required/optional and scope policy.

plugins.name: workhub
plugins.description: Task-board, schedule and vault knowledge-base skills and hooks for the workhub vault (task-list, task-start, task-report, schedule-edit, mindmap-edit, vault-init, vault-setup, vault-migrate, kb-ingest, kb-query, kb-lint, kb-index, memory-setup, memory-recall, strategist), the secretary agent that fields the owner's decisions, plus the workhub app's own release procedure (release-app).

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Engineering utilities and helpers for software development tasks.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Productivity helpers for administrative and daily tasks, including Zenn blog writing.

plugins.name: team-ops
plugins.description: Team operations on a shared folder as the single source of truth: team knowledge base, file-based product backlog, sprint ceremonies, multi-repo progress tracking, and daily burndown/spec reporting.

plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: Generic Obsidian format helpers: Obsidian Flavored Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas, Obsidian CLI, and Defuddle web clipping.

plugins.name: persona
plugins.description: Switchable response personas with a shared token-reduction engine: bundled characters (genshijin, noctis, lunafreya, ignis), user-defined characters that survive plugin updates, three compression levels persisted across sessions, a persona-switch CLI other skills can call, character-agnostic commit/review/compress/stats/crew helpers, and an MCP description-shrinking proxy. Derived from genshijin (MIT).

plugins.name: stack-cloudflare
plugins.description: Helpers for developing on Cloudflare (Workers, Pages, R2, D1, etc.).

plugins.name: stack-dnd-kit
plugins.description: Helpers for building drag-and-drop UIs with dnd kit.

plugins.name: stack-opencode
plugins.description: Helpers for working with OpenCode configuration and extensions.

plugins.name: stack-react-router
plugins.description: Helpers for React Router and Remix applications.
